src/lib/components/ModifyInteraction.rea.description: Allow editing vertices in a VectorLayer and report the updated features.

id.description: The ID used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

layerId.description: Dash ID of the VectorLayer to modify; defaults to the first vector layer on the map.

modifiedGeoJSON.description: Read-only: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of the target layer after a modify operation.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied callback used to write component state back to the layout.

source.description: Built-in tile source identifier. Currently supports OSM.

url.description: URL template for a custom XYZ tile source.

src/lib/components/VectorLayer.react.js.description: Render GeoJSON features in a canvas-backed OpenLayers vector layer.

id.description: Dash component ID; also used by ModifyInteraction to target this vector layer.

geojson.description: GeoJSON Feature or FeatureCollection with coordinates in [longitude, latitude] order; updates are rendered in the map projection.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied callback used to write component state back to the layout.

src/lib/components/VectorTileLayer.react.description: Render Mapbox Vector Tiles from an MVT endpoint with an OpenLayers flat style.

id.description: Component ID used to identify this layer in the Dash layout.

url.description: MVT URL template containing {z}, {x}, and {y} or {-y}; ignored when urls is provided.

urls.description: Alternative MVT URL templates for load balancing; takes precedence over url.

projection.description: Projection of the vector tile grid; use the CRS served by the tile endpoint.

attributions.description: Attribution text or a list of attribution strings for the tile provider.

style.description: OpenLayers flat-style object used to style MVT features.

setProps.description: Dash-supplied callback used to write component state back to the layout.
